title: 第20章 倚天剑第21章 乾坤鼎
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰看着这百亩灵药，顿时豪气干云
每亩种植了3000株灵药，百亩就是30万株，不过叶辰不打算将灵药卖出，他现在需要积攒丹药来培养势力
将来培养千万仙兵，所需要的丹药是无法估算的，别人培养势力，害怕丹毒，不敢用丹药大量培养，再一个也没能力用海量的丹药来培养
叶辰却不同，他有混沌珠，随着境界的提升，随着各种资源的投入，混沌珠就可以有足够的空间来种植灵药
加上混沌珠内可以大量的缩短成熟的时间，再者叶辰炼制的丹药颗颗都是完美级的丹药，颗颗都是精品，根本没有丹毒，唯一的缺点就是，用丹药培养的修士普遍境界浮夸，不过叶辰是谁，他乃堂堂仙帝，自然有办法磨炼这些缺点，叶辰的成长必然伴随着血雨腥风，实战肯定多不胜数，
看着这些丹药，这就是根基，就是未来，叶辰将这百亩的灵药全部收取之后，分类整理放入储物戒指中，这些灵药可以炼制出，淬体丹，洗髓丹丹，回气丹，聚气丹，精气丹。这些都是目前急需要的丹药
看来需要培养炼丹师了，炼器师也要列入计划了，万事开头难，一步一步来吧。
叶辰感慨一番之后，静下心来，做好今日之事
叶辰取出了秋香的哥哥临死赠送的戒指，一把地器倚天剑，这把剑灵性十足，风属性，和雷鸣剑配合可以使用两仪剑阵了。
有了两仪剑阵，筑基境不靠魂刺偷袭，也可以正面抗衡一二了
叶辰取出雷鸣剑以气御剑，阴阳两级，二龙出海，……叶辰修炼了两个时辰，风雷两仪剑法就已入门了。
这若是让那些剑师看见了不惊掉下巴才怪，两个时辰剑阵入门，有史以来，最快的修剑之人乃是万年前的剑仙李逍遥，两仪剑法最快的保持者用了一个月的时间，而叶辰竟然只用了两个时辰
叶辰不知道的是他所修炼的逍遥剑法，正是这位剑仙所创，那是叶辰前世意外所得
叶辰将两柄剑收入丹田，培养剑气，炼气境就可以将地器收入丹田中，不需要再背着剑，当然背着剑也可以培养的，地器之下的剑是无法收入丹田的
当然叶辰乃是混沌体，倒是不受限制，炼气境丹田已经变成气旋了，混沌体又是可以吸收任何的物质和能量。雷鸣剑自然就可以放在丹田之中了
叶辰带着小墨继续往深处出发，小墨时不时的就能采到一株灵药，小墨大多数都是交给了叶辰，妖兽天然的对灵药比较敏感
经过了半个月的长途跋涉，叶辰终于走到了核心区域，怪不得一些圣地都会培养飞行妖兽，一些低阶修士靠赶路就需要几个月了，金丹境就可以飞行了，元婴境就可以有本命法宝了，至少必须是天器。
玄黄大陆的武器分类为，帝器，尊器，王器，天器，地器，玄器，凡器
小墨在前面引路，这里有一处山谷，被阵法笼罩，前面有几百人在猛烈的估计阵法，领头的是几位金丹境修士，看衣服应该是四大宗门的
叶辰找了一个隐蔽的地方，用神识探查一番，竟然是复合阵法，九宫天罡阵和九转迷幻阵。

“你们慢慢破吧！小爷先走一步了”，叶辰偷偷摸摸的走向远处，找到一处阵眼。
叶辰用手掌附在光幕上，运转噬灵诀，此诀是前世灭了一个魔道宗门，在叶辰将所有功法全部据为所有，一些特别霸道的功法一部分被叶辰销毁，一部分列为禁书，封存
噬灵诀乃是吞噬他人灵力的魔道功法，不过后来叶辰改良了，可以吞噬一些具有灵力的物质，不再需要必须吞噬他人的攻法
content_en:
Ye Chen looked at the hundreds of acres of elixir and suddenly felt so proud.
There are 3,000 elixir plants planted per acre, and 100 acres equals 300,000. However, Ye Chen does not plan to sell the elixir. He now needs to accumulate elixirs to cultivate his power.
In the future, the number of elixirs required to cultivate tens of millions of immortal soldiers is immeasurable. Others are afraid of the elixirs when cultivating forces, and dare not use elixirs to cultivate them in large quantities. No one else has the ability to use massive amounts of elixirs to cultivate them.
Ye Chen is different. He has Chaos Beads. As his realm improves and various resources are invested, the Chaos Beads will have enough space to plant elixirs.
In addition, the chaos beads can greatly shorten the maturation time. Moreover, the elixirs refined by Ye Chen are all perfect-level elixirs. They are all high-quality and have no erysipelas at all. The only drawback is that the monks trained with elixirs are generally exaggerated. But who is Ye Chen?
Looking at these elixirs, this is the foundation and the future. After Ye Chen collected all the elixirs from the hundred acres, he sorted them into storage rings. These elixirs can be refined into body tempering elixirs, marrow cleansing elixirs, Qi recovery elixirs, Qi gathering elixirs, and energy essence elixirs. These are the elixirs that are urgently needed right now
It seems that it is necessary to train alchemists, and weapon refiners should also be included in the plan. Everything is difficult at the beginning, so let's do it step by step.
After Ye Chen sighed with emotion, he calmed down and finished what he had to do today.
Ye Chen took out the ring that Qiuxiang's brother gave him before he died, and an earthly weapon called the Yitian Sword. This sword is full of spirituality and has wind attributes. When combined with the Thunder Sword, the Liangyi Sword Formation can be used.
With the Liangyi Sword Formation, the Foundation Establishment Realm can compete head-on with one or two without relying on soul stabs for sneak attacks.
Ye Chen took out the Thunder Sword and used Qi to control the sword. There were two levels of Yin and Yang, and the two dragons went out to sea... Ye Chen had practiced for two hours, and he had already mastered the Feng Lei Liang Yi Sword Technique.
It would be strange if those sword masters didn't drop their jaws in shock when they saw this. The two-hour sword formation was introduced. In history, the fastest swordsman was Li Xiaoyao, the swordsman from ten thousand years ago. The fastest holder of Liangyi swordsmanship took a month, but Ye Chen only took two hours.
What Ye Chen didn't know was that the Xiaoyao Sword Technique he practiced was created by this swordsman. It was accidentally obtained by Ye Chen in his previous life.
Ye Chen put the two swords into his dantian and cultivated the sword energy. At the Qi Refining stage, he could put the earth weapon into his dantian. There was no need to carry the sword on his back. Of course, he could also cultivate the sword while carrying it. The sword under the earth weapon could not be put into his dantian.
Of course, Ye Chen is a chaotic body, but he is not restricted. The Dantian in the Qi Refining Realm has turned into a cyclone, and the chaotic body can absorb any matter and energy. The Thunder Sword can naturally be placed in the Dantian.
Ye Chen took Xiao Mo and continued to go deeper. Xiao Mo could collect a spiritual medicine from time to time. Most of them were handed over to Ye Chen. Monsters are naturally sensitive to spiritual medicine.
After half a month of long journey, Ye Chen finally reached the core area. No wonder some holy places will cultivate flying monsters. Some low-level monks need to travel for several months before they can fly in the Golden Core Realm and have their own magic weapon in the Nascent Soul Realm. At least it must be a heavenly weapon.
The weapons in Xuanhuang Continent are classified into imperial weapons, honorable weapons, royal weapons, heavenly weapons, earthly weapons, mysterious weapons, and mortal weapons.
Xiao Mo leads the way. There is a valley here, which is shrouded by formations. There are hundreds of people in front of them who are fiercely evaluating the formations. The leaders are several Jindan realm monks. Judging from their clothes, they should be from the four major sects.
Ye Chen found a hidden place and used his spiritual sense to investigate. It turned out to be a composite formation, the Nine Palace Tiangang Formation and the Nine Revolutions Psychedelic Formation.
"You guys break it slowly! I took the first step." Ye Chen sneaked towards the distance and found an opening.
Ye Chen attached his palm to the light screen and ran the Soul Devouring Technique. This technique was used to destroy a demonic sect in his previous life. Ye Chen took possession of all the techniques. Some particularly domineering techniquesPart of the law was destroyed by Ye Chen, and part of it was listed as a banned book and sealed.
The Spirit Devouring Technique is a demonic technique that swallows other people's spiritual power. However, Ye Chen later improved it so that it can swallow some spiritual substances and no longer has to swallow other people's attacks.
